notes.title: Patch Note – Prologue v0.2a Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Hello Bazaar Folks!
We’re back with a fresh update for the Prologue version!
This patch strengthens the core systems, enhances visuals, and finally introduces one of the most anticipated features: Multiplayer mode! 🎮🌐
[hr][/hr]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Mode
You can now build your market with friends, make sales together, and complete tasks as a team!
[hr][/hr]💡 Graphics & Lighting Improvements
The in-game lighting system has been updated.

Ambient lighting is now more natural and warm.

Sunrises, sunsets, and the day-night cycle are more realistic than ever.
[hr][/hr]🌿 Environmental Enhancements
Natural elements on the map (trees, ground textures, shadows) are now more detailed.

The market area feels more atmospheric and vibrant.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed some crashes occurring during game startup.

Resolved bugs that caused certain tasks to get stuck.

Visual glitches and UI inconsistencies have been addressed.
[hr][/hr]
🎮 A smoother experience for new players and a much more fun market adventure with multiplayer support await you!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you and happy selling! 💰🧺

notes.title: Bazaar Simulator - Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
After months of development and the release of our Prologue and Demo versions, we are excited to announce that   Bazaar Simulator will launch in Early Access on January 30, 2025


Our Early Access roadmap will be available soon. You can join our Discord channel to access this information.

notes.title: Bazaar Simulator Devlogs #1
notes.content:
Hello, Bazaar Simulator Fans!

We’re excited to share some new features that make managing your market even easier and more enjoyable! As we move towards the full release, we're sharing these updates with you piece by piece to keep you in the loop.
 Streamlined Management with Handcarts
New handcarts  will  make transporting your goods easier and faster than ever. Effortlessly organize crates of products in your marketplace, saving precious time and making your business operations smoother and more efficient.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/67523b983b6155444dc5b2a1c7c0a8755401b81b.gif
Single Item Sales: Spice Up Your Offerings
You will be able to sell individual items like cabbages, watermelons, and more. This feature will let you showcase your products one by one, giving customers a more personalized shopping experience. Diversify your strategies and keep your market fresh and engaging!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051738/f25b68ca0f7e7cf94b564c6011f515cb675b916f.gif

We’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions! Your feedback is invaluable to us and helps shape the future of Bazaar Simulator.

See you in the next devlog!

Thank you,
The Bazaar Simulator Development Team

notes.title: Fish Products, Digital Scale and Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone !

Thank you for playing Bazaar Simulator Prologue.

Below are the fixes and new features that come with our first major patch:

New Features Added:


 Fish Products:You can now sell fish in the market. Add different types of fish to your stall to offer to your customers.
 Scale Mechanic: The mechanic for purchasing and placing scales has been added to the game. You can add a scale to your stall and change its position at any time.
 Digital Scale: A digital scale has been added to the game for precise measurements. This allows you to weigh your products more accurately.
 Environment and Lighting Adjustments: Environmental improvements and enhanced lighting have been made in the game world, creating a more impressive market atmosphere.


Fixed Issues:


 Translation Errors: Translation errors in Korean, Chinese, and Japanese languages have been corrected. Other translation errors in various languages have also been fixed.
 Resolution Issues: The issue where buttons could not be clicked when changing resolution has been resolved. You can now enjoy a seamless gaming experience at different resolutions.
 Price Update Bug: The issue where prices did not update after closing and reopening the game has been fixed.
 Scale Bowl Bug: The bug that prevented the scale bowl from being picked up has been resolved. Scale bowls now work smoothly.
 Level System and Economy Balance: The level system and in-game economy have been balanced. The game flow is now more balanced.
 Price Calculation Updates: Updates have been made to the price calculation area, allowing you to manage prices more accurately.
 Stall Placement Issues: Issues caused by placing stalls too close together have been resolved.
 End of Day and Payment Issues: Problems such as end-of-day errors and incorrect payments after customer orders have been fixed.
 Money Box Issues: Problems encountered when clicking on the money box have been resolved. Money transactions now work smoothly.
 Bagging Bug: The bug causing the game to freeze when clicking on another bag while holding a bag has been fixed.
 whosale market Section Issues: The issue where money was not received when products were taken in the wholesale marketsection has been resolved.
 Visual and Cosmetic Improvements: In-game visual enhancements and cosmetic changes have been made.
 Product Transfer Bug: The issue where products fell off the stall when transferring from the bag back to the bowl has been fixed.
 Market Product Issues: The bug that prevented products from being deleted or increased in certain situations in the market has been resolved.
 Tutorial Improvements: Improvements have been made to the tutorial section of the game.
 Character Clipping Issue: The issue of the character getting stuck when transferring products to the bag has been resolved.
 Product Save Bug: The bug causing purchased products not to be saved in certain situations has been fixed.
 Start Day Issue: The situation where it was unclear that you needed to go to the scale to start the day has been addressed.


Please report any issues you encounter during the game on our Discord channel so we can produce solutions as soon as possible!

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1a
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Bazaar Simulator Prologue.

Below are the fixes included in the first quick patch:



  Bugs on the shop side have been fixed.
  The issue caused by stalls being too close to each other has been resolved.
  Price tag issues have been fixed.
 The bugs and product-dropping issues when moving the stall have been fixed.
 The issue of not working correctly at the end of the day in some cases has been resolved.
 The issue where customers paid the wrong price after placing an order has been fixed.
 Issues related to clicking the cash box have been resolved.
 The bug causing the game to freeze when clicking on a bag while holding another bag has been fixed.
 The issue of not receiving money when products are taken in the exhibits section has been resolved.
 The economy has been improved.
 Visual improvements and cosmetic changes have been made.
 Improvements have been made to the tutorial section.



Please let us know if you encounter any issues on our Discord so that we can fix them as soon as possible
